katekasesa.p: [Kata+ekasesa] (ti) CL=7 (Nāmarupa: physical and mental objects of consciousness) that is one member of the group representing all (or) any of the others.

[ cf. ekasesa, q.v. ] , ( t.t.gr. ) formu- lated with the remaining of one ( word ); — gramm. lit.: gaṇane dasassa dvikatikacatukkapañcakachakka- sattakaṭṭhaka-navakānaṃ sarūpānaṃ ~ānaṃ yathā- saṅkhyaṃ vī ti cattāra paññā sa satt' asa nava ice ete ādesā honti, Kacc-v ad Kacc 391 = Sadd 799, 11 ; — nāmaṃ khandhattayaṃ; rūpaṃ, bhūtavatthâdi- kaṃ mataṃ. ~aṃ taṃ tassa, tādisass' eva paccayo, Vism 562, 18* foll. = Vibh-a 173, 29* foll.; for the gram- matical implications of this description, cf., e.g., Sadd 779, 7 ( ad sutta 737 [= sarūpa-ekasesa]) qu. Vism 562, 23 : nāmañ ca rūpañ ca nāmarūpañ ca nāma- rūpaṃ; Sadd 780, 7 ( ad sutta 742 [= virūpa-sarūp'- ekasesa]: saḷāyatanañ chaṭṭhāyatanañ ca saḷāyata- naṃ) ≠ Vism 562, 24 ( cf . Vism-mhṭ ll 321, 15 foll ); Sadd 797, 10 foll. (= virup'-ekasesa); — ° -pada , n., a word formulated with the remaining of one ( word ); purisā itthiyo ti ādīni ~āni, Sadd 779, 31 .
